ModMetaData.name: Waylith Runtime Fixes [1.7]
ModMetaData.author: RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
针对 RimWorld 1.7 Waylith 的两处已验证缺陷：渲染线程出错后，等待渲染空闲时能够转发错误；CPU 纹理对象被回收后，修正遗漏的内存统计扣减。此补丁不会恢复失败的 GPU，也不属于通用卡顿、显存不足或内存泄漏修复。未知引擎构建会跳过相应补丁并记录原因。
Fixes two verified RimWorld 1.7 Waylith defects: propagates render-thread failures during idle waits, and balances CPU texture-memory accounting when pixel objects are collected. Does not recover a failed GPU or promise a general performance or memory-leak fix. Unsupported engine builds are skipped with a diagnostic message.
